description: Defines reference counting classes and smart pointer template for QUIC in the quiche project.

classes.name: QuicheReferenceCounted
classes.description: Base class for explicitly reference-counted objects in QUIC.

classes.name: QuicheReferenceCountedPointer
classes.description: Template class for reference-counted smart pointers in QUIC.

methods.name: QuicheReferenceCountedPointer()
methods.description: Default constructor for the smart pointer.

methods.name: QuicheReferenceCountedPointer(T* p)
methods.description: Constructs smart pointer from raw pointer, assumes reference count of 1.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Dereference operator for the referenced object.

methods.name: operator->
methods.description: Member access operator for the referenced object.

methods.name: get()
methods.description: Returns raw pointer without changing reference count.
